scope: Proposition 9.5 (Fixed-frame convergence and uniqueness) of the manuscript “Uniqueness of tangent flows at the first singular time of embedded surface mean-curvature flow” (preprints/Tangent-flow-uniqueness-2026-09-24/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 355 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 19b2f77a4cbfb0d5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 97. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The rescaled flow converges smoothly on every fixed compact set, at all rescaled times, to S in the original ambient coordinates. For the smooth closed embedded surface flow and fixed first singular point of Theorem 1.1, every backward tangent flow consequently equals the multiplicity-one homo- thetic motion √ −s S at every negative time s.
